title: Alternating Pumps
description: Securing a system and achieve equal wear by alternating pumps in parallel. This tool helps manage pump alternation strategies to ensure equal wear distribution and system reliability.

components.content:
## Key Considerations

### When to Use Backup Pumps

Choosing between one or more backup pumps depends on:

- **System criticality** - How critical is the operation (e.g., hospital water supply vs. home cooling system)
- **Costs** - Installation and maintenance costs of backup pumps
- **Delivery and installation time** - How quickly a replacement pump can be obtained and installed

### Benefits and Drawbacks of Automatic Pump Alternation

**Advantages:**
- Extends the time before repair and reinvestments
- Distributes wear evenly across all pumps
- Reduces premature failure of individual pumps

**Disadvantages:**
- All pumps may wear out at the same time
- Reduces operational safety for the whole system when all pumps fail simultaneously
- Requires sophisticated control systems
